design: Prospective source-intake comparison after candidate, compiler, comparator and extraction-prompt freeze. Independent same-session source selector/oracle does not disclose inputs or labels to constructor until freeze; labels remain withheld until candidate outputs are sealed.
offering: A complete source-linked dependency-call assessment for an exact public consumer component and an exact upstream source transition, distinguishing a supported argument conflict, conditional binding preservation and the precise unresolved execution or dispatch evidence still needed.

selection.sample_basis: Purposive structural coverage, not a random population sample, defect prevalence estimate, observed paid demand, or six independent package families.
selection.freshness: Historical public source snapshots not inspected by this study's constructor before freeze. Public descriptions and pretraining may have exposed historical changes. Oracle selector sees source to construct labels independently. No source is modified or synthesized for primary work.
selection.recurrence: Actual upstream release transitions and real downstream consumer code establish maintenance opportunities. Their use as repeated paid work is modeled, not observed. Two questions share one consumer with different actual dependency transitions and are clustered.
selection.bounds: One source component can contain multiple declared functions or methods. Every relevant call within those scopes belongs to that one job. Each task carries the unchanged full consumer file, 2–24 source files, at most 24 relevant calls, below original core byte bounds.

inclusion: All AST calls within the registered source scopes that directly call an imported dependency symbol, a statically evidenced dependency receiver, or an inherited dependency initializer. Aliases, local imports and direct export modules are included. Plain returned-value operations, unrelated dependencies, builtin receiver construction and own consumer helpers are excluded with an inspectable rationale.

supported_conclusions.binding: Exact arguments bind the named ordinary source declaration before and after, under successful argument evaluation and standard imports. This does not prove full behavior, values, types, runtime dispatch, security or deployment readiness.
supported_conclusions.unresolved: Constructor/descriptor dispatch, decorators, expanded arguments or unproved target identity remain unresolved according to the unchanged product core. No supplemental evidence overwrites its classification or makes an unknown SAFE.
supported_conclusions.evaluation: Complete call inventory plus valid target evidence or a justified refusal; no wrong target, omitted dependency call, duplicated representation or unsubstantiated defect. Report decisive coverage separately from complete unresolved packets.

arms.A: Actual curator-assisted public-source to existing pack workflow, all prior tools/caches retained.
arms.B: Current-session model extracts a typed source-linked proposal; a frozen deterministic compiler and unchanged product core perform exact validation, constraints, critique and verification.
arms.C: Strong ordinary AST/import/alias/dataflow/reexport implementation, with equal raw sources, permission to retain useful assets and the same core.

resource_account: Charge all source acquisition, oracle work, construction, failed preparation, model extraction and correction, deterministic compilation, verification, packaging and retained assets. Model/authoring money and active attention stay unknown when not metered; wall time is not converted to a wage.
analysis: One registered primary pass, no feedback-tuning against primary outcomes. All six jobs and all errors remain. Any correction after disclosure is exploratory and separately registered. Report paired descriptive outcomes by job and by two families, not p-values or population-quality claims from this small purposive sample.
oracle: Manual whole-scope inventory and source attribution, plus an independently reconstructed Python argument binder. It does not import or execute upstream package bodies, use candidate output as ground truth or trust the product's self-acceptance. Same-session task independence, not independent institutional replication.
execution: Inert AST analysis only. No consumer, network client, provider, contract, operator, credential, daemon or financial operation is invoked.
preservation: Original owner code, experiments, publications and primary negative market outcomes remain unchanged. All task sources match upstream Git blob SHA-1 and SHA-256 identities with original license notices.
pre_freeze_preparation: An initial draft numerical before-window included decorated baseline declarations outside original core's supported scope. Before any candidate saw task bodies or outcomes, the selector chose an earlier actual baseline release so the corpus includes decidable ordinary declarations as well as genuinely unresolved cases. This is disclosed purposive coverage design, not a post-outcome exclusion or candidate-tuned result.
